scope: existing A3/B4 instance for one original Metadata snapshot; not a new trust grant
contracts: fixed original Aeneas value models and translation trust
domain: valid Rust shared borrow of the same already obtained x86_64 Linux std::fs::Metadata; arbitrary u32 owner
representation: three-getter projection Snapshot(uid:U32, mode:U32, isDirectory:Bool); not a new runtime layout or live filesystem

operations.contract: A3 mechanical snapshot read, B4 original receiver binding
operations.Pre: valid original Metadata snapshot, fixed std version/target, matching three-field projection
operations.Input: the same original shared Metadata receiver; no path or new syscall
operations.normal: the uid field observed by this Metadata value; represented as Result.ok of the matching projection field
operations.Frame: does not mutate this Metadata or perform filesystem IO; no claim that external filesystem state is unchanged
operations.Fault: Rust getter has no io::Result error; invalid memory/UB outside domain; panic/unwind/abort/nonreturn do not establish a normal poststate or cleanup
operations.Budget: field/file-type read only, no new allocation or real-time scheduling guarantee
operations.caller: provide this original observation and expected owner; do not replace with client-supplied or another object snapshot
operations.source_evidence: both fixed production1.97 and extraction nightly std fs, os/unix, os/linux and sys/fs/unix sources
